title: A spatial regression approach to modeling urban land surface temperature
author: Ismaila, Muhammed, et al.

steps.title: Select and Prepare Data
steps.instruction: Acquire Landsat and SRTM DEM data at 30 m spatial resolution for the study area (greater than 8000 hectares).

steps.title: Initialize Software Environment
steps.instruction: Set up the necessary GUI software packages for data processing and analysis.

steps.title: Calculate Spectral Indices
steps.instruction: Convert all relevant bands to top of atmosphere (ToA) reflectance and calculate the following indices using the specified bands:

substeps.instruction: Calculate NDBI using the formula: (SWIR1 - NIR) / (SWIR1 + NIR)
Calculate NDVI using the formula: (NIR - RED) / (NIR + RED)
Calculate MNDWI using the formula: (GREEN - SWIR1) / (GREEN + SWIR1)

steps.title: Retrieve Surface Albedo
steps.instruction: Retrieve Albedo from Landsat 8 OLI data based on Landsat 7 ETM+ equivalent using the following formula: Albedo = (0.356α2 + 0.130α4 + 0.373α5 + 0.085α6 + 0.072α7 - 0.0018) / (0.356 + 0.130 + 0.373 + 0.085 + 0.072), where α represents Landsat 8 OLI bands 2, 4, 5, 6, and 7.

steps.title: Perform Spatial Regression Modeling
steps.instruction: Construct a regression model to quantitatively measure the relationship between the dependent variable and independent variables.

substeps.instruction: Set Land Surface Temperature (LST) as the dependent variable
Set NDBI, NDVI, MNDWI, Albedo, and Digital Elevation Model (DEM) from SRTM data as the explanatory (independent) variables
